blogs.title: The CA-125 Paradox: Interpreting Ovarian Tumor Markers in Pregnancy
blogs.description: Explore the physiological rise and fall of Ca-125 levels across the three trimesters. Discuss how to differentiate benign physiologic elevation from signs of ovarian neoplasia in the second trimester and why a single readings lack diagnostic weight compared to serial trend analysis.

blogs.title: Safe Imaging in the Obstetric Emergency: US, MRI and Gadolinium Controversies
blogs.description: Analyze the hierarchy of diagnostic imaging when evaluating pelvic masses. Highlight why non-contrast MRI is preferred over CT or Gadolinium-enhanced MRI during pregnancy and how ultrasound parameters (color Doppler) can predict vascular viability and torsion risk.

blogs.title: When to Operate on Pregnancy: Indications for Myomectomy and Laparotomy
blogs.description: Review the clinical thresholds for surgical intervention in a pregnant patient with symptomatic uterine masses. Contrast the risks of 'wait-and-see' vs. immediate exploration for torsion, necrosis, or hemodynamic compromise, and address the feasibility of laparotomy before viability end.

blogs.title: Obstetric Logistics: Managing Spinal Masses and Labor Distortion
blogs.description: Determine the impact of fixed pelvic uterine masses on the expulsive phase of labor. Use this case to outline why massive posterior wall leiomyomas necessitate planned Cesarean duties rather than expectant natural delivery, focusing on fetal head engagement and secondary C-section planning.

blogs.title: Fevers and Fluids: Distinguishing Mass Ischemia from Urinary Tract Infection
blogs.description: Analyze how to prioritize workup when a pregnant patient presents with abdominal pain, fever, and discharge vs. unknown source. Discuss the triage of Klebsiella pneumonia associations versus necrosis/leakage of morula cysts to avoid unnecessary antibiotics or inappropriate invasive procedures.

blogs.title: The Iron-Deficiency'anemia Loop and Perioperative Planning
blogs.description: Explain the synergy between vascular pelvic masses, heavy menstrual history, and anemia during pregnancy. Provide algorithms for transfusion triggers and iron supplementation in patients undergoing myomectomy, emphasizing how advanced anemia affects hemodynamic stability during abdominal surgery.
